==Notes==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Quicksand]].
* [[Attack Skill]]s will trigger this spirit's effect twice.
* This is the only elite Nature Ritual that has a 30 second recharge time; all others have a 15 second recharge time.
* Great synergy with [[Famine]].
* This skill will trigger more often against foes using [[IAS]] or hexed with [[Reckless Haste]].
* Combines well with [[Quickening Zephyr]] for an energy hostile environment.

== Trivia ==
*The male [[Paragon]] in the [[skill icon]] seems to be the same as in [[Tripwire]].
